<?php
/**
 * FluentAffiliate: two active affiliates and one waiting for approval, with visits from their links and referrals
 * on the shop's orders (some waiting for a payout, one being checked).
 */
use FluentAffiliate\App\Models\Referral;
use FluentAffiliate\App\Models\Visit;

$orders = (array) get_option('anypress_sample_orders', []);
foreach ($sample['affiliates'] as $a => [$who, $status, $referrals]) {
    $p = $sample['people'][$who];
    $userId = anypress_sample_user($p);
    if (!$userId) {
        continue;
    }
    [, $made] = anypress_sample_api('POST', '/fluent-affiliate/v2/affiliates', [
        'user_id' => $userId, 'status' => $status, 'rate_type' => 'default', 'payment_email' => anypress_sample_email($p),
        'note' => $status === 'pending' ? 'Applied from the affiliate page. Runs a style blog.' : '',
    ]);
    $affiliateId = (int) ($made['affiliate']['id'] ?? 0);
    if (!$affiliateId) {
        continue;
    }
    // Visits from the affiliate's link over the month.
    for ($v = 0; $v < 6 + $a * 4; $v++) {
        $visit = Visit::create([
            'affiliate_id' => $affiliateId,
            'url' => home_url('/?ref=' . $affiliateId),
            'referrer' => ['https://www.instagram.com/', 'https://www.pinterest.com/', 'https://www.google.com/'][$v % 3],
            'utm_campaign' => $v % 2 ? 'winter' : '',
            'ip' => '',
        ]);
        $visit->created_at = anypress_sample_when(28 - $v * 2.2, 12 + $v % 9);
        $visit->save();
    }
    foreach ($referrals as [$orderIndex, $refStatus]) {
        $order = isset($orders[$orderIndex]) ? \FluentCart\App\Models\Order::find($orders[$orderIndex]) : null;
        if (!$order) {
            continue;
        }
        [, $ref] = anypress_sample_api('POST', '/fluent-affiliate/v2/referrals', [
            'affiliate_id' => $affiliateId,
            'amount' => round($order->total_amount * 0.3 / 100, 2),
            'description' => 'Order #' . $order->id,
            'status' => $refStatus === 'paid' ? 'unpaid' : $refStatus,
            'type' => 'sale',
        ]);
        $referral = Referral::find((int) ($ref['referral']['id'] ?? 0));
        if ($referral) {
            // Tied to the order it came from, as FluentAffiliate's FluentCart integration does at checkout.
            $referral->provider = 'fluent_cart';
            $referral->provider_id = $order->id;
            $referral->order_total = $order->total_amount / 100;
            $referral->currency = $order->currency;
            $referral->created_at = $order->created_at;
            $referral->save();
        }
    }
}

<?php
/**
 * FluentBooking: two hosts with their own calendars and weekly hours (lunch off, Saturday mornings, a day off next
 * week), the business's services, and a fortnight of bookings: some done, most coming up, one cancelled.
 */
use FluentBooking\App\Models\Availability;
use FluentBooking\App\Models\Booking;
use FluentBooking\App\Services\BookingService;
use FluentBooking\App\Services\CalendarService;

$plan = $sample['bookings'];
$people = $sample['people'];
$week = static function (bool $saturday): array {
    $day = ['enabled' => true, 'slots' => [['start' => '09:00', 'end' => '12:30'], ['start' => '13:30', 'end' => '17:00']]];
    return [
        'sun' => ['enabled' => false, 'slots' => []],
        'mon' => $day, 'tue' => $day, 'wed' => $day, 'thu' => $day, 'fri' => $day,
        'sat' => $saturday ? ['enabled' => true, 'slots' => [['start' => '10:00', 'end' => '14:00']]] : ['enabled' => false, 'slots' => []],
    ];
};

$events = [];
foreach ($plan['hosts'] as $h => [$who, $bio]) {
    $userId = anypress_sample_user($people[$who]);
    if (!$userId) {
        continue;
    }
    wp_update_user(['ID' => $userId, 'description' => $bio, 'role' => 'editor']);
    $made = CalendarService::createCalendar([
        'title' => $people[$who][0] . ' ' . $people[$who][1],
        'description' => $bio,
        'user_id' => $userId,
    ]);
    $calendar = is_array($made) ? ($made['calendar'] ?? null) : null;
    if ($calendar) {
        // A host calendar takes its host's login as its title; the booking page shows the host's name instead.
        $calendar->title = $people[$who][0] . ' ' . $people[$who][1];
        $calendar->save();
    }
    $default = $calendar ? $calendar->events()->first() : null;
    if (!$default) {
        continue;
    }
    // Weekly hours: lunch off, Saturday mornings for the first host, and a day off next week.
    $hours = Availability::find($default->availability_id);
    if ($hours) {
        $value = $hours->value;
        $value['weekly_schedules'] = $week($h === 0);
        $value['date_overrides'] = [gmdate('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . (8 + $h) . ' days')) => []];
        $hours->value = $value;
        $hours->key = $h === 0 ? 'Studio hours' : 'Coaching hours';
        $hours->save();
    }
    $mine = array_values(array_filter($plan['events'], static fn ($e) => $e[0] === $h));
    foreach ($mine as $n => [, $title, $minutes, $price, $where, $about]) {
        $location = ['phone' => 'phone_guest', 'in_person' => 'in_person_organizer', 'online' => 'online_meeting'][$where];
        $fields = [
            'title' => $title,
            'description' => $about . ($price ? ' $' . number_format($price / 100) . ', paid at the session.' : ' Free.'),
            'duration' => $minutes,
            'location_type' => $location,
            'location_settings' => [['type' => $location, 'title' => $where === 'in_person' ? '14 Willow Lane, Suite 2' : '', 'display_on_booking' => '']],
            'status' => 'active',
        ];
        if ($n === 0) {
            foreach ($fields as $key => $value) {
                $default->{$key} = $value;
            }
            $default->save();
            $slot = $default;
        } else {
            CalendarService::createCalendarEvents($calendar, [$fields + [
                'event_type' => 'single',
                'availability_type' => 'existing_schedule',
                'availability_id' => $default->availability_id,
            ]]);
            $slot = $calendar->events()->where('title', $title)->first();
        }
        foreach ($plan['events'] as $index => $event) {
            if ($event[1] === $title) {
                $events[$index] = $slot;
            }
        }
    }
}

$notes = ['Lower back has been tight since the move.', 'First time, a little nervous!', 'Would like to focus on pricing.', '', 'Running 5 minutes late is OK?', ''];
foreach ($plan['bookings'] as $n => [$event, $who, $daysAhead, $hour, $status]) {
    $slot = $events[$event] ?? null;
    if (!$slot) {
        continue;
    }
    $p = $people[$who];
    $start = strtotime('today ' . $hour . ':00 UTC') + $daysAhead * DAY_IN_SECONDS;
    // Weekends move to Monday, as the hours above allow.
    while (in_array(gmdate('w', $start), ['0', '6'], true)) {
        $start += DAY_IN_SECONDS;
    }
    try {
        $booking = BookingService::createBooking([
            'first_name' => $p[0],
            'last_name' => $p[1],
            'email' => anypress_sample_email($p),
            'phone' => '+1 555 01' . str_pad((string) (10 + $n), 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
            'message' => $notes[$n % count($notes)],
            'start_time' => gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', $start),
            'person_time_zone' => 'America/Los_Angeles',
            'status' => 'scheduled',
            'source' => 'web',
        ], $slot);
    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
        continue;
    }
    if ($booking instanceof Booking && $status !== 'scheduled') {
        $booking->status = $status;
        if ($status === 'cancelled') {
            $booking->internal_note = 'Cancelled by the client: travelling that week.';
        }
        $booking->save();
    }
}

    $titles = (array) get_option('rank-math-options-titles', []);
    update_option('rank-math-options-titles', array_merge($titles, [
        'knowledgegraph_type' => 'company',

    foreach (get_posts(['post_type' => 'post', 'numberposts' => -1]) as $post) {
        update_post_meta($post->ID, 'rank_math_description', wp_trim_words(wp_strip_all_tags($post->post_content), 22));
        // The focus keyword: the title's first words, without punctuation or a dangling "a", "your" or "and".
        $words = array_slice(preg_split('/\s+/', trim(preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9 ]+/', ' ', strtolower($post->post_title)))), 0, 4);
        while (count($words) > 1 && in_array(end($words), ['a', 'an', 'the', 'your', 'and', 'or', 'to', 'of', 'for', 'in', 'on', 'we', 'is', 'how', 'with'], true)) {
            array_pop($words);
        }
        update_post_meta($post->ID, 'rank_math_focus_keyword', implode(' ', $words));
    }
}

/**

use FluentForm\App\Models\Form;
use FluentForm\App\Models\Submission;
use FluentForm\App\Services\Submission\SubmissionService;

/** One entry, as a submission saves it: the entry, its details and its id hash. */
$entry = static function (Form $form, array $data, float $daysAgo, string $status, bool $starred = false): void {
    $previous = (int) Submission::where('form_id', $form->id)->max('serial_number');
    $when = anypress_sample_when($daysAgo, 9 + (int) ($daysAgo * 7) % 9);
    $submission = Submission::create([
        'form_id' => $form->id,
        'serial_number' => $previous + 1,
        'response' => wp_json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
        'source_url' => home_url('/contact/'),
        'user_id' => 0,
        'status' => $status,
        'is_favourite' => $starred ? 1 : 0,
        'browser' => ['Chrome', 'Safari', 'Firefox'][(int) $daysAgo % 3],
        'device' => ['Windows', 'iPhone', 'Mac', 'Android'][(int) $daysAgo % 4],
        'country' => 'US',
        'created_at' => $when,
        'updated_at' => $when,
    ]);
    (new SubmissionService())->recordEntryDetails($submission->id, $form->id, $data);
    \FluentForm\App\Helpers\Helper::setSubmissionMeta($submission->id, '_entry_uid_hash', md5(wp_generate_uuid4() . $submission->id), $form->id);
};

/**
 * Sample content for a site type's demo on WordPress Playground: a made-up business set up in every plugin the site
 * type has on, so a visitor can open any screen in wp-admin and see it working (blog, CRM, forms, shop, bookings,
 * help desk, affiliates, community, course). Demo only: "Make this my site" carries the visitor's pages, styles, menus
 * and business details to the store, never this content.
 *
 * Everything is made through each plugin's own REST routes (as its admin screens do) or its own models and services,
 * never SQL on its tables. Each part runs only when its plugin is on for this site type. No email leaves Playground.
 */

/** One of the plugin's own REST routes, as its admin screens call it. Answers [status, data]. */
function anypress_sample_api(string $method, string $route, array $params = []): array
{
    $request = new WP_REST_Request($method, $route);
    if ($method === 'GET') {
        $request->set_query_params($params);
    } else {
        $request->set_header('content-type', 'application/json');
        $request->set_body((string) wp_json_encode($params));
    }
    $response = rest_do_request($request);
    return [$response->get_status(), $response->get_data()];
}

/** A time $days ago (negative: ahead), at $hour UTC, as MySQL wants it. */
function anypress_sample_when(float $days, int $hour = 10): string
{
    return gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', (int) (strtotime('today ' . $hour . ':00 UTC') - $days * DAY_IN_SECONDS));
}

/** The sample person's email address. */
function anypress_sample_email(array $person): string
{
    return strtolower($person[0] . '.' . $person[1]) . '@example.com';
}

/** A WordPress user for a sample person (subscriber), made once. */
function anypress_sample_user(array $person): int
{
    $login = strtolower($person[0] . $person[1]);
    $id = username_exists($login) ?: wp_insert_user([
        'user_login' => $login,
        'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(),
        'user_email' => anypress_sample_email($person),
        'display_name' => $person[0] . ' ' . $person[1],
        'first_name' => $person[0],
        'last_name' => $person[1],
        'description' => $person[4] ?? '',
        'role' => 'subscriber',
    ]);
    return is_wp_error($id) ? 0 : (int) $id;
}

        require ANYPRESS_SAMPLE . '/' . $part . '.php';
    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
        // A part a plugin refuses is left out; the rest of the demo still has its content.
        echo "Sample $part: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
    }
    if (getenv('ANYPRESS_SAMPLE_TIMING')) {
        printf("%s %.1fs\n", $part, microtime(true) - $started);
    }
}

/**
 * FluentCart: its own sample catalogue in four categories at real prices, a subscription and a gift card, two
 * coupons, and a month of orders (paid, shipped, processing, one refunded, one waiting for payment) from customers
 * with addresses, so the reports have numbers in them. Payments stay in test mode.
 */
use FluentCart\Api\Resource\CustomerResource;
use FluentCart\Api\Resource\OrderResource;
use FluentCart\App\Models\Customer;
use FluentCart\App\Models\Order;
use FluentCart\App\Models\ProductVariation;

$shop = $sample['shop'];

$before = get_posts(['post_type' => 'fluent-products', 'numberposts' => -1, 'fields' => 'ids', 'post_status' => 'any']);
foreach ($shop['products'] as [$set, $count]) {
    for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
        \FluentCart\App\Services\Async\DummyProductService::create($set, $i);
    }
}
$mark = static function (string $what) {
    static $t;
    if (getenv('ANYPRESS_SAMPLE_TIMING')) {
        printf("  shop %s %.1fs\n", $what, microtime(true) - ($t ?: $t = microtime(true)));
    }
    $t = microtime(true);
};
$mark('catalogue');
$products = array_values(array_diff(
    get_posts(['post_type' => 'fluent-products', 'numberposts' => -1, 'fields' => 'ids', 'post_status' => 'any', 'orderby' => 'ID', 'order' => 'ASC']),
    $before
));

// Real prices (the sample catalogue's are placeholders), one item on sale, and categories a shopper would expect.
$prices = ['hoodie' => 5800, 'sweatshirt' => 4800, 't-shirt' => 2400, 'cap' => 2200, 'jacket' => 8900, 'jeans' => 6800, 'dress' => 7200, 'sweater' => 6400, 'leggings' => 3800, 'shorts' => 3200, 'nightgown' => 4800];
foreach ($products as $n => $postId) {
    $title = strtolower(get_the_title($postId));
    $price = 4500;
    foreach ($prices as $word => $cents) {
        if (strpos($title, $word) !== false) {
            $price = $cents;
        }
    }
    // In cents, as FluentCart keeps prices; one product per update, as its bulk editor sends them.
    $updates = [];
    foreach (ProductVariation::where('post_id', $postId)->get() as $v => $variation) {
        $updates[] = ['id' => $variation->id, 'item_price' => $price + $v * 200, 'compare_price' => $n === 2 ? $price + 2000 : null];
    }
    anypress_sample_api('POST', '/fluent-cart/v2/products/variants/bulk-update', ['updates' => $updates]);
    foreach ($shop['categories'] as $category => $words) {
        foreach ($words as $word) {
            if (strpos($title, $word) !== false) {
                wp_set_object_terms($postId, [$category], 'product-categories', false);
                break 2;
            }
        }
    }
}
$mark('prices');

// A monthly subscription and a digital gift card.
$extra = [];
foreach (['subscription' => ['physical', ['payment_type' => 'subscription', 'repeat_interval' => 'monthly']], 'gift' => ['digital', ['payment_type' => 'onetime']]] as $key => [$fulfillment, $info]) {
    [$title, $about, $cents] = $shop[$key];
    $made = (new \FluentCart\App\Services\BulkProductInsertService())->insertChunk([[
        '_cid' => $key,
        'post_title' => $title,
        'post_excerpt' => $about,
        'post_content' => $about,
        'post_status' => 'published',
        'detail' => ['fulfillment_type' => $fulfillment, 'variation_type' => 'simple'],
        'variants' => [['item_price' => $cents, 'other_info' => $info]],
    ]]);
    $extra[$key] = (int) ($made['created'][0]['id'] ?? 0);
    if ($extra[$key]) {
        wp_set_object_terms($extra[$key], ['Accessories'], 'product-categories', false);
    }
}

foreach ($shop['coupons'] as [$title, $code, $kind, $amount, $note]) {
    anypress_sample_api('POST', '/fluent-cart/v2/coupons', [
        'title' => $title, 'code' => $code, 'type' => $kind, 'amount' => $amount, 'status' => 'active',
        'stackable' => 'no', 'show_on_checkout' => 'no', 'notes' => $note,
    ]);
}

/** The shop's customer for a sample person, with a billing and shipping address. */
$customerFor = static function (array $p, int $n): ?Customer {
    $customer = Customer::where('email', anypress_sample_email($p))->first();
    if (!$customer) {
        CustomerResource::create(['email' => anypress_sample_email($p), 'full_name' => $p[0] . ' ' . $p[1], 'first_name' => $p[0], 'last_name' => $p[1]]);
        $customer = Customer::where('email', anypress_sample_email($p))->first();
    }
    if ($customer && !$customer->primary_billing_address) {
        foreach (['billing', 'shipping'] as $kind) {
            anypress_sample_api('POST', "/fluent-cart/v2/customers/{$customer->id}/address", [
                'type' => $kind, 'is_primary' => 1, 'label' => 'Home', 'name' => "$p[0] $p[1]", 'email' => anypress_sample_email($p),
                'address_1' => (100 + $n * 17) . ' Oak Street', 'city' => $p[2], 'postcode' => (string) (10000 + $n * 911), 'country' => 'US',
            ]);
        }
    }
    return $customer;
};

/** One order placed from the admin screen's own path, then moved to what happened to it. */
$orders = [];
$place = static function (Customer $customer, array $lines, float $daysAgo, string $outcome) use (&$orders): void {
    $items = [];
    foreach ($lines as [$variation, $quantity]) {
        $items[] = [
            'object_id' => $variation->id, 'post_id' => $variation->post_id, 'quantity' => $quantity,
            'unit_price' => $variation->item_price, 'title' => $variation->variation_title, 'post_title' => get_the_title($variation->post_id),
            'fulfillment_type' => $variation->fulfillment_type, 'other_info' => $variation->other_info,
            'payment_type' => $variation->payment_type ?: 'onetime',
        ];
    }
    $order = OrderResource::updatedPlaceOrder(['customer_id' => $customer->id, 'order_items' => $items]);
    if (!$order instanceof Order) {
        return;
    }
    if ($outcome !== 'pending') {
        anypress_sample_api('POST', "/fluent-cart/v2/orders/{$order->id}/mark-as-paid", ['payment_method' => 'offline_payment']);
    }
    if ($outcome === 'shipped') {
        anypress_sample_api('PUT', "/fluent-cart/v2/orders/{$order->id}/statuses", ['action' => 'change_shipping_status', 'statuses' => ['shipping_status' => 'shipped']]);
    }
    if ($outcome === 'paid') {
        anypress_sample_api('PUT', "/fluent-cart/v2/orders/{$order->id}/statuses", ['action' => 'change_order_status', 'statuses' => ['order_status' => 'completed']]);
    }
    if ($outcome === 'refunded') {
        $transaction = \FluentCart\App\Models\OrderTransaction::where('order_id', $order->id)->first();
        if ($transaction) {
            anypress_sample_api('POST', "/fluent-cart/v2/orders/{$order->id}/refund", ['refund_info' => ['transaction_id' => $transaction->id, 'amount' => $transaction->total, 'cancelSubscription' => false, 'manageStock' => true]]);
        }
    }
    // The order's own dates, so a month of sales shows on the reports.
    $when = anypress_sample_when($daysAgo, 11 + (int) $daysAgo % 8);
    foreach ([Order::class, \FluentCart\App\Models\OrderTransaction::class] as $model) {
        foreach ($model === Order::class ? [Order::find($order->id)] : $model::where('order_id', $order->id)->get() as $row) {
            if ($row) {
                $row->created_at = $when;
                $row->updated_at = $when;
                $row->save();
            }
        }
    }
    // The store's CRM lifecycle tags the buyer as checkout does (its hooks wait for a real payment).
    if ($outcome !== 'pending' && class_exists('AnyPress_CRM_Lifecycle')) {
        $paid = Order::find($order->id);
        foreach ($paid->subscriptions()->get() as $subscription) {
            AnyPress_CRM_Lifecycle::on_subscription_active(['subscription' => $subscription]);
        }
        AnyPress_CRM_Lifecycle::on_order_paid(['order' => $paid, 'customer' => $customer]);
        if ($outcome === 'refunded') {
            AnyPress_CRM_Lifecycle::on_full_refund(['order' => $paid, 'customer' => $customer]);
        }
    }
    $orders[] = $order->id;
};

$variants = [];
foreach ($products as $postId) {
    $variants[] = ProductVariation::where('post_id', $postId)->first();
}
foreach ($shop['orders'] as $n => [$who, $daysAgo, $lines, $outcome]) {
    $customer = $customerFor($sample['people'][$who], $n);
    $picked = $variants ? array_map(static fn ($l) => [$variants[$l[0] % count($variants)], $l[1]], $lines) : [];
    if ($customer && $picked) {
        $place($customer, $picked, $daysAgo, $outcome);
    }
}
$subscription = $extra['subscription'] ? ProductVariation::where('post_id', $extra['subscription'])->first() : null;
foreach ($subscription ? $shop['subscribers'] : [] as $n => $who) {
    $customer = $customerFor($sample['people'][$who], 20 + $n);
    if ($customer) {
        $place($customer, [[$subscription, 1]], 20 - $n * 6, 'paid');
    }
}
update_option('anypress_sample_orders', $orders, false);
$mark('orders');
